description: This Java class 'AddressData' is a data transfer object (DTO) representing address information within the Apache Fineract project. It encapsulates properties related to address details, such as street, city, location identifiers, and options for select fields. The class includes multiple constructors and static factory methods for creating instances with various levels of details and default/null values, and uses Lombok annotations for getters.
